timingDecision: Keep published covered ranges in localized guidance. Use their upper endpoint as a fixed planning allowance. Light duration = total endpoints minus that allowance; sum of stages reproduces source total window. This is an explicit app adaptation, not measured independent light-stage bounds. Actual confirmations recalculate future actions; date is guidance. Presoak is before sowing and excluded from harvest totals.
snapshotCompatibility: V2 stages use new localized keys; historical v1 keys, source titles and stored recipe values remain unchanged. No migration of existing batches or personal recipes.

dispositions.resolution: Every density now has a traceable mass, area, source and no-germination-adjustment assumption; no Penn State exact-number attribution.
